compatibility: All existing task/review fields remain. approved_task_config generated with prepared_delivery.task_config(task); new records append review_protocol and source_authorization. Ordinary focused H3 accepts one self-review. 1..3 concrete core obligations.
sample_selection: prepared_focused.py select-sample --tasks frozen-tasks.json --main-session-id REAL_ID --output sample.json; tasks JSON is ordered full task array, frozen batch binds IDs/revisions before random sampling. Each finite whitelist entry still has binding, status approved_for_automatic_publication, approved_task_path.
evidence_requirement: The raw native session export must itself bind session/parent, task/revision in request and result, neutral request material list, successful read_file calls for each claimed read, and unflagged pass result. The wrapper cannot supply missing facts or change result values. Read coverage includes statement/proof/context/preamble/external references and all asset/bibliography inputs. Adapt real native output only; never synthesize calls from self-report booleans. Native API field adaptation remains subject to calibration.
reservation_requirement: New reservation requests must include review_protocol. Existing old reservations cannot silently change protocol.
authorization_requirement: Each whole-file asset/bibliography input must be in source_record.allowed_files using original input path (string or object.path). Any exclusion on that file rejects whole-file inclusion.

dsh_direct_range.command: python prepared_dsh_evidence.py --parent-log parent/session.v4.jsonl --child-log child/session.v4.jsonl --material sources/paper.tex --material neutral.json --neutral-material neutral.json --ranges ranges.json --evidence-root EVIDENCE_ROOT --output normalized-review.json
dsh_direct_range.neutral_input: Only task/revision binding, source ranges and standard prerequisites; no prior review, difficulty reason, checks, verdict, or initial rationale. It must be read in full.
dsh_direct_range.source_review_requirement: Native read(file_path,offset,limit) must cover every task statement/proof/context/preamble/external range. Actual copied asset/bibliography inputs require full-file read coverage. No text or content fingerprints are compared.
dsh_direct_range.provenance: Use --evidence-root with the sample/evidence package root. Parent/child JSONL references are stored relative to that root and resolved within it on validation. Native headers.cwd and native read absolute paths remain unchanged. Move the whole evidence package without editing normalized content. validate-sample and publication use sample.json parent as evidence root. Parent may be multi-turn or still running its current turn after the matched child result; child remains fresh, one-shot, completed.
neutral_wrapper_allowlist: You are an independent read-only reviewer.
Return only the required JSON object.
Do not write files or use other tools.
